title: LearnerVoice: A Dataset of Non-Native English Learners’ Spontaneous Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems by comparing Word Error Rates (WER) on a newly constructed non-native (L2) English speech dataset against native speech datasets, and conducting a detailed error taxonomy analysis to identify failure modes related to non-native accents and L2-specific spontaneous speech features.
